evals.prompt: Fetch all Sonar findings for my current branch from https://sonar.example.com, project Example. SONAR_TOKEN is already configured. Wait for my instructions afterward.
evals.expected_output: Detects branch, checks branch and PR analyses, retrieves all pages of issues and hotspots read-only, reports scope, counts and output path without printing credentials.

evals.prompt: On Windows, fetch PR 123 findings for Example at https://sonar.example.com. My token file is C:\Users\dev\secrets\sonar-token.txt.
evals.expected_output: Uses py -3 and the supplied token path without displaying its contents; output defaults to the OS temporary directory.

evals.prompt: Get findings for feature/example. The server has two matching PR analyses and hotspots may require more permissions.
evals.expected_output: Asks which PR analysis to retrieve; does not silently choose. If hotspots are forbidden, retains issues and reports partial retrieval.
